"Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5 out of 5 stars)
Date of Service: 20 July 2025
Full tune-up and spoke replacement on my front wheel.
After hitting a pothole and bending a spoke. From the moment I contacted Gear Grow Cycle the staff, especially Akash was incredibly friendly and professional. As it is a doorstep service, everything was transparent and see through. He quickly reachd the location where I was down with my bike& assessed the damage and recommended a full tune-up as well, explaining everything clearly. I received a transparent quote via email and in front within minutes. They assembled everything in front of me and there was no doubt of excellent work bike was ready, which was earlier than expected!
When I took for trial , my bike felt brand new. The shifting is incredibly smooth, the brakes are perfectly adjusted, and the new spoke blends seamlessly. Akash walked me through all the work they did and gave me some great tips for chain maintenance. The price was very reasonable for the quality of work.
Excellent communication, speedy service, highly skilled mechanics, fair pricing.
Would I recommend? Definitely!
I'm so impressed with Gear Grow Cycle. They not only fixed my immediate problem but also made my bike ride better than it has in years. Fantastic service all around. I'll be coming back for all my future bike needs!

Whether it’s routine servicing, engine tuning, brake repair, oil changes, or advanced diagnostics, we handle it all with precision and care. We use only high-quality parts and tools to ensure your vehicle performs at its best.

Why Choose Us?

Trusted, experienced mechanics

Fast and reliable service

Competitive pricing

Genuine spare parts

Customer satisfaction guaranteed

Visit us today and experience hassle-free two-wheeler servicing that you can rely on!

I recently had the pleasure of experiencing the exceptional quality and performance that Cycle Worx brings to the world of cycling, and I must say, I am thoroughly impressed. As an avid mountain biking enthusiast, I sought out a brand that not only understands the unique demands of off-road adventures but also excels in delivering high-quality cycles and accessories. Cycle Worx surpassed my expectations on every front.
Cycle Worx cycles are a testament to precision engineering and uncompromising build quality. The frames are robust and durable, providing the perfect blend of strength and agility needed for conquering challenging mountain trails. The attention to detail in craftsmanship is evident, making each ride a joyous and confident experience.
My experience with Cycle Worx was not only defined by their outstanding products but also by their exceptional customer service. The team is knowledgeable, responsive, and genuinely passionate about ensuring customers find the perfect fit for their cycling needs.😀
100% Recommended.

Warm Regards,
Rugved Pawar
